structural_control: The gold slot, answer choices, and existing passages remain fixed; unrelated passages are appended.
resource_amendment_before_16_or_32_passa: Each unrelated passage is the first 16 whitespace-delimited words of its first natural SQuAD sentence. Prompt token lengths are reported. This bounds eager-attention cost without changing the gold passage, answer choices, nesting, circuit, conditions, or endpoints.
implementation_optimization_before_16_or: During intervention evaluation, only the frozen selected layer materializes attention weights; non-selected layers use PyTorch scaled-dot-product attention. Plain competence screening uses scaled-dot-product attention throughout. The selected-layer distribution, permutation, diagnostics, examples, and endpoints are unchanged.
dataset_split_amendment_before_full_outc: SQuAD validation yielded only about 760 constructible single-token candidates, below the frozen 1536-candidate pool. Full runs therefore use the SQuAD train split; calibration and evaluation IDs remain disjoint within every seed. The failed validation attempts ended before competence screening and produced no full outcomes.
candidate_pool_amendment_before_full_cau: The first train-split seed yielded 158 eligible examples from an 8x pool, below the frozen 192 required. Full runs therefore use a 12x candidate pool while retaining exactly 64 calibration and 128 evaluation examples. The failed attempt stopped at the competence gate before calibration or intervention.
matched_control_optimization_after_seed0: Seed 0 used the exact quadratic closest-gap search. Before seeds 1 and 2, it was replaced by an exact sort-plus-two-pointer closest-gap search to remove quadratic work at 32 passages. Both optimize the same absolute gap error; matched-control source mass and the complete sorted attention spectrum remain invariant. Unit tests compare the optimized result with exhaustive search. Seed-0 outcomes were not rerun or altered.
competence_rule: At four passages: full-context correct, gold-only correct, and no-context incorrect.
selection_rule: Select four heads by calibration utility gain at four passages, then freeze layer and heads at every longer context.
primary_endpoints: baseline source mass at 32 minus 4 passages
baseline answer margin at 32 minus 4 passages
source_max minus matched-control answer margin at 32 passages
secondary_endpoints: source-max rescue amplification from 4 to 32 passages
success_rule: At least two full-size competent seeds; upper 95% hierarchical CI below zero for long-minus-short source mass and margin; lower 95% CI above zero for source-max minus matched-control margin at 32 passages; maximum spectrum-invariant error at most 1e-5.
second_model_rule: Run SmolLM2 unchanged. A competence-gate failure is reported as a scope boundary and is not replaced after inspecting causal outcomes.
